entities.summary: Zvonko Buljan is a Croatian professional basketball power forward. A well traveled player, he has played in over ten countries, including in the Greek Basket League and the German Basketball Bundesliga. In 2014, he won both the Slovenian championship and the Slovenian Basketball Cup.
